replies.author: @triadmoh9991
replies.text:
Communism is not the problem in Cuba.
This video, made the clear the hard facts of a life of shortages in Cuba. 
It has omitted to clarify on the cruel actions of the oppressive US which is the villian of the piece.
Since 1962, Cuba has had to face a hostile USA which has done everything possible to economically strangle the country.
Till the erstwhile Soviet Union existed, it was an effective bulwark against every US action.
Things moved from bad to worse after 1991 when the Soviet Union collapsed.
Cube has been labouring under US sanctions for the last almost 70 years, of which, the last 30 have been the hardest.
Once the Trump Administration took over, its practice of squeezing all & sundry focussed fully on Cuba.
After the fall of Venezuela to US machinations, Cuba has been existing under a full US naval blockade which allows no trade or oil import.
For the last few decades, the UN General Body has voted every year to condemn the US actions against a small island nation which amounts to crimes against humanity.
I wish this video had honestly exposed the real reasons for the poverty in Cuba & the villainous acts of the neo colonial US.

replies.author: @Globallife.documentary
replies.text: I sincerely appreciate your comment and for being part of our community. We aimed to capture the raw truth of their daily struggle while honoring their enduring spirit. How do you see the future unfolding for places facing such deep economic challenges?
